diagnosis.host_transport_state: The Host ledger records 9 ACKed frames and a clean terminal close after the client requested close.
diagnosis.client_failure: The ninth successful frame response was rejected by client telemetry validation before client frame counters advanced.
diagnosis.root_cause: hostFrameElapsedMs uses Environment.TickCount64 in the Host while client HTTP timing uses Stopwatch in a separate process. The fatal hostFrameElapsedMs <= clientRoundTrip+10ms comparison crossed independent clock domains/resolutions and was invalid.
diagnosis.pacing_assessment: No SESSION_PACING_VIOLATION occurred in attempt 004; the 50 ms client / 40 ms Host margin survived until the unrelated telemetry abort.
diagnosis.correction: Keep all response hash/frame/packet/byte identity checks. Treat hostFrameElapsedMs as bounded telemetry only (0..5000 ms reviewed ACK budget), and record signed client-minus-Host elapsed residual without using it as a fatal cross-clock ordering invariant.
